[i]Marcus thought long and hard. Joining the EDU as it currently stood would be challenging for Versia. Versia's centralized, top-down government would need to restructure its view of it's own  citizens and the military, and it might require loosening restrictions on state-controlled goods, thus diluting the Rex's power. If Versia joined the EDU, Marcus thought, it could spark division and unrest after a millennium of unwavering state control. A bead of sweat trickled down his face.

"My King... I ask that we form a bilateral pact between our two nations, one forged on our own terms. Of course, I mean no offense."[/i][/quote]
Jorik III. watched Marcus closely, reading the hesitation in his posture, the flicker of thought behind his eyes. The High King was not a man easily fooled, he could see when a warrior was wrestling with unseen burdens. The weight of his kings command, the future of his nation, the fear of what such a decision could mean for Versia.
A bead of sweat rolled down the Legatus face before he spoke.
"My King... I ask that we form a bilateral pact between our two nations, one forged on our own terms. Of course, I mean no offense."
For a moment, Jorik was silent. Then, a slow chuckle rumbled in his throat. It was not the laughter of mockery, but of understanding. He leaned back in his throne, his fingers tapping idly against the wolf-carved armrests.
"No offense taken, Legatus," he mused. "I see now why your Rex sent a soldier instead of a diplomat.He needed a man who understands duty, who carries the burden of empire on his shoulders." His piercing gaze locked onto Marcus. "You fear that joining the Elseyran Defense Union would weaken the Rexs rule. That it would demand changes that your people may not yet be ready to make. You are right to be cautious. A warrior does not step onto uncertain ground without first testing its strength."He lifted his horn of mead, swirling the golden liquid inside. "Very well. If Versia is not yet ready to stand with Elseyr as a whole, then let us begin with something smaller, but no less powerful."Jorik leaned forward, his voice steady, authoritative. "Jomsland will forge a separate pact with Versia. A true warriors bond, military cooperation, trade, and mutual defense, based on both of our terms."
He raised his drink once more. "To the warriors of Versia and Jomsland. May our enemies learn to fear our names!"
The hall erupted in cheers and the clash of tankards.

Are you ok with the following changes to Article 5.2 and the Addition of Article 2.5 to resolve the conflict between national interests and collective defense? Also should there be an addition to Article 2.2 for nations without an army?
[spoiler=Changes] 5.2 No member shall be forced to participate in military actions or economic policies that contradict its national interest, unless such participation is deemed essential for the collective defense of the EDU, as determined by the Defense Althing.
2.5 Any member state seeking exemption from participation in a military operation due to national interest shall submit a formal request to the Defense Althing, which shall review and make a determination based on the EDUs collective security needs.[/spoiler]
Article 5.2 now includes a provision where a member can opt out of military actions, but only if participation is not deemed essential for collective defense, with the decision made by the Defense Althing.
Article 2.5 adds a clear mechanism for requesting an exemption through the Defense Althing, ensuring that such requests are handled within the framework of collective security.[/quote]

The great kingdom of Ekpatanus fully supports the beneficial changes brought about by Article 5.2 and announces its positive vote regarding the incorporation of Article 2.5. However, concerning Article 2.2, we still believe that the presence of countries that lack sufficient military capability to defend their nations only results in additional costs and burdens for the other EDU member states.

[spoiler=[b][u]Stranded Far From Home.[/u]
Dreams Till Sunrise.[/b]
[nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation] [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]]
[i]The night is heavy with the distant storm ceasing to be, breathing masks hang gently from their compartment with emergency lights glowing green to their exits.
660 souls including the crew of the aircraft with the only casualties being Pilot, co-pilot and a young flight attendee, as for the rest of the passengers would wake up to their natural senses to the scenario they now are in.
The reality of every man, woman and child on a island they know little about would become ever increasingly worrying, the chosen leaders of the survivors would take an hour's worth of calming down before a selected group was chosen.
This group of 8 to represent the 660 different people, spoke in their native tongue but know enough to understand one another well enough to work together.
With everyone still inside the aircraft, one of the doors had to be closed down as the cool breeze outside brought discomfort for the young.
The reason for the door and deployed inflatable ramp at the front of the aircraft was the act of not just 1, but of 13 panicked passengers who now are unknown to where they ran off to.
As the quietness develops for the now stranded people, all they can do is wait for the sun to rise...

But as a child looks out a window, she glimpsed at a strange light afar in the distance...
Before she could identify what she is looking at, it vanishes into the darkness of plain and empty landscape of sand and dry soil.
She'll be the only one who knows that every passenger on the Boeing 747 are all strangers in a strange land, and no one she knows would believe her warning. [/i][/spoiler]
